verdict.rationale: LangGraph is open-source and its persistence layer (checkpointers/stores) can be backed by standard databases like Postgres that the user fully controls, implying inherent data portability, but there is no explicit 'export' feature or documented open-format export/leave workflow. missing for 10: an explicit data export tool or documented format spec, guidance on migrating away, and any independent confirmation that stored state can be cleanly extracted and reused elsewhere.
